items.text: A person who only replies when you initiate every thread is showing initiative but not proactiveness.
Equal partnerability can be proven by self-belief alone, without timestamped two-way communication.
Proactiveness means the person volunteers ideas, risks, or next steps without being tapped.
A long silence after months of thank-you-only replies is evidence that should be weighed on the partner-to-tool scale.
If someone always does the work only after you assign it, they are already at the top of the partner scale.
Initiative without proactiveness can still show integrity when tapped - that is different from full partnerability.
Uploading undated screenshots without timestamps is enough for a gold JaPoP static score.
A blank communications folder is not a fail and not a zero; it is deferred evidence.
Myers-Briggs or OCEAN results should be treated as the gold medal over dated message counts.
Division of labor can be qualitative; partnerability still requires reciprocal, dated engagement - not one-sided push.
